answer_1.quote: Recently, researchers made significant progress in text generation: translation , structured data-to-text , dialogue generation , and summarization .
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs across multiple NLG tasks including machine translation, dialogue generation, data-to-text, and summarization using both automatic and human evaluations.

answer_2.quote: Automatic metrics such as rule-based metrics (e.g. n-gram matching BLEU , chrF ) and distance-based (e.g. TER ) have been commonly used in text generation evaluations because they are fast and domain invariant.

answer_4.quote: We hired 3 professional linguists to annotate 1000 testing samples from WMT21 De-En News domain using MQM human evaluation procedures .
answer_4.guideline: Following the prior study , we hired 3 bilingual linguists in English and German. Following MQM evaluation procedure , each rater can only access the source (in German) and model output (in English), without any reference text. Rater is given all the choices of possible error typologies and definitions of the severity levels.
